title: Model Metadata v1 Migration Plan (Inventory + Backfill Checklist)
content:
Spreadsheet-style notes (represented as text). This doc is the working inventory + checklist for migrating existing model records to Model Metadata Schema v1 and generating forward-looking changelogs.

Last updated: 2025-10-14 (Michael Nguyen)
Primary reviewers: Quentin Harris (schema), Connor O'Brien (release), Svetlana Petrenko (audit), Diego Santos (multi-deployment)

============================================================
TAB 0 — QUICK SUMMARY
============================================================
Goal: migrate existing model registry records to metadata_v1 with required field coverage sufficient for:
- safe rollout eligibility checks
- customer-visible release notes generation
- internal audit trail + support queries
- packaging constraints for Private (offline bundles)

Migration approach (current):
1) Land schema + validation tooling (ENG-9821) in registry repo; add fixtures.
2) Backfill existing records with best-effort defaults + targeted manual curation for high-traffic models.
3) Gate promotions on required fields + redaction rules.
4) Emit change events from control plane on create/update/promote/deprecate.

Key principle: public vs internal separation must be explicit; do not “default publish” any notes. Public notes require explicit field(s) set.

Current top risks:
- Silent promotions for pinned versions (esp. Dedicated) if backfill incomplete.
- Private bundles missing required compatibility data (tokenizer/runtime) → upgrade failures.
- Internal-only notes leaking via Console/docs surfaces if redaction rules regress.

============================================================
TAB 1 — REQUIRED FIELDS CHECKLIST (METADATA V1) + DEFAULTS
============================================================
Legend:
- R = required for v1 validation (hard fail)
- C = conditionally required (depends on deployment mode / feature usage)
- S = strongly recommended (for quality + supportability; can be soft fail initially)

Fields (human-readable mapping; see schema for canonical names):
1) Model identity
- model_id (R) — stable slug used in API/catalog
- display_name (R)
- family (R) — e.g., llama, mistral, qwen, embedding
- task_types (R) — chat, completion, embedding, rerank

2) Versioning
- version_semver (R) — e.g., 2.3.1
- release_channel (R) — stable | preview | deprecated
- created_at / published_at (S)

3) Runtime + tokenizer compatibility
- runtime_min_version (R)
- tokenizer_id + tokenizer_sha (C) — required for Private bundles and when tokenizer changes
- quantization_profile (C) — required when serving quantized variants
- supported_context_lengths (S)

4) Deployment availability + constraints
- availability_by_deployment (R) — Hosted/Dedicated/Private + regions where applicable
- dedicated_sla_eligible (C) — if offered on Dedicated
- private_bundle_eligible (C)

5) Rollout + safety
- rollout_eligibility (R) — allowed rollout types (canary, A/B) + constraints
- rollback_strategy_hint (S)
- safety_notes_public (S) + safety_notes_internal (S)

6) Release notes / change visibility
- change_summary_public (C) — required on promotion to stable channel
- change_summary_internal (S)
- change_categories (C) — security/breaking/perf/quality/bugfix/deprecation
- deprecation_policy (C) — if deprecated or scheduled

7) Quality signals (hooks)
- eval_run_ids (S) — must be linkable to evidence; avoid overclaiming
- guardrails_outcomes (S)

Defaulting rules (proposal; still under review):
- If tokenizer info unknown and deployment != Private: allow temporarily with TODO + soft warning.
- If change categories missing on preview promotions: allow; require before stable promotion.
- For older records: set created_at to first-seen timestamp; published_at to first stable promotion.

============================================================
TAB 2 — INVENTORY OF EXISTING MODEL RECORDS (PRIORITIZED)
============================================================
Columns:
A model_id | B current_record_source | C current_version_format | D deployments (H/D/P) | E traffic_tier | F current_field_coverage_est | G backfill_needed (short) | H risk_class | I owner | J migration_status | K notes

Traffic tiers:
- T0 = top 10% traffic / enterprise critical
- T1 = meaningful traffic
- T2 = low traffic / long tail

Risk class:
- High = pinned enterprise usage OR Private bundle OR known prior incidents
- Med = moderate usage or complex constraints
- Low = low usage, simple mapping

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
llama-3.1-70b-instruct | model-registry(db) + docs | tag-like ("2025-08") | H/D | T0 | ~55% | semver mapping; runtime_min; public change summary template | High | Quentin Harris | In progress | Dedicated customers pin; need explicit breaking/quality language. Ensure rollout_eligibility excludes A/B in some regions due to capacity.
llama-3.1-8b-instruct | model-registry(db) | partial semver ("3.1") | H/D/P | T0 | ~60% | tokenizer_sha for Private; quant profiles list | High | Diego Santos | Not started | Private bundle requires tokenizer_id+sha + runtime_min_version. Confirm context length list.
llama-3.2-3b-instruct | docs + runtime-config | semver-ish | H | T1 | ~40% | availability_by_deployment; rollback hint; safety notes | Med | Michael Nguyen | Not started | Mostly hosted only; ensure public notes don’t mention internal kernel changes.
qwen2.5-72b-instruct | model-registry(db) | tag-like | H/D | T0 | ~45% | semver; quality notes; eval_run_ids | High | Jonas Weber | Blocked | Waiting on eval harness run IDs tagged with schema hash.
mistral-large-2 | model-registry(db) | semver-ish | H/D | T1 | ~50% | change_categories; deprecation fields (older variant) | Med | Paula Mendes | Not started | Requires clear deprecation timeline for previous "mistral-large" alias.
hermes-3-70b | model-registry(db) | none | H | T2 | ~25% | almost all; especially versioning + compatibility | Low | Michael Nguyen | Not started | Long tail; can set to preview channel initially.
redwood-embed-v2 | model-registry(db) | semver 2.0.x | H/D/P | T0 | ~70% | private_bundle eligibility; tokenizer info | High | Diego Santos | In progress | Embeddings used in regulated workloads; ensure audit + changelog coverage.
redwood-rerank-v1 | model-registry(db) | semver 1.4.x | H/D | T1 | ~65% | rollout constraints; quality summary | Med | Jordan Lee | Not started | Rerank regressions show up quickly; include rollback hint.
e5-large-v2 | docs only | none | H | T2 | ~15% | import into registry; assign semver; availability | Low | Quentin Harris | Not started | Legacy; may be deprecated once new embed models fully cover.
bge-m3 | model-registry(db) | semver-ish | H | T1 | ~45% | tokenizer_sha? (if any), quality notes | Med | Jonas Weber | Not started | Verify if tokenizer changes across builds; otherwise keep stable.
llama-3.1-70b-instruct-awq | runtime-config | variant tag | H/D | T0 | ~30% | quantization_profile required fields | High | Quentin Harris | Not started | Quant profile needs explicit numeric params + perf notes. Ensure compatibility constraints.
llama-3.1-70b-instruct-gptq | runtime-config | variant tag | H | T1 | ~25% | quantization_profile; safety notes | Med | Quentin Harris | Not started | Hosted only for now.
llama-3.1-8b-instruct-fp8 | runtime-config | variant tag | D/P | T1 | ~35% | availability_by_deployment; runtime_min | High | Diego Santos | Not started | Dedicated runs; Private feasibility TBD.
vision-mini-v1 | docs + experimental | none | H | T2 | ~20% | task_types; safety notes; rollout eligibility | Med | Michael Nguyen | Not started | Treat as preview only; avoid overpromising.
code-llm-small | model-registry(db) | semver 0.x | H | T2 | ~35% | deprecation policy (planned) | Low | Paula Mendes | Not started | Planned deprecation; need dates + recommended replacement.

Notes:
- Any record with “docs only” must be created in registry before we can generate events/changelog.
- Quantized variants: we should decide whether they are separate model_ids or variants under a base model_id. Current inventory reflects mixed reality.

============================================================
TAB 3 — BACKFILL TASK BREAKDOWN (BY FIELD) + SOURCES OF TRUTH
============================================================
Field | Source of truth | Automation possibility | Notes

version_semver | release eng mapping + registry | partial automation | Need deterministic conversion for tag-like versions. For top models: manual confirmation.
availability_by_deployment | control plane config | automatable | Pull from existing runtime config and deployment inventory.
runtime_min_version | serving runtime team | partial | Often implicit; need to annotate by model family + features used.
tokenizer_id + tokenizer_sha | model artifacts store | partial | Must be exact for Private. If missing: block Private eligibility; allow Hosted/Dedicated with warning.
quantization_profile | runtime config + benchmark harness | partial | Standardize naming: awq/gptq/fp8/int8 + params.
rollout_eligibility | policy engine (Jordan) | mostly manual | Rules depend on safety, capacity, and known issues.
change_categories + summaries | release eng + PR labels | manual at first | Eventually from events; for migration, backfill minimal “Initial v1 migration” internal note.
quality/evals links | eval harness | partial | Must avoid public claims without significance criteria.
audit metadata (actor/approver) | control plane events | automatable | For historical data, may be incomplete; acceptable to mark as “unknown/system-import”.

============================================================
TAB 4 — MIGRATION CHECKLIST BY DEPLOYMENT MODE
============================================================
A) Hosted (API)
[ ] Ensure model_id matches public catalog slug (no breaking rename)
[ ] availability_by_deployment includes Hosted + regions
[ ] rollout_eligibility set (canary allowed? A/B allowed?)
[ ] Public/internal change summaries for stable promotions
[ ] Redaction tests for Console + docs
[ ] Monitoring: changelog generation success rate, missing fields count

B) Dedicated
[ ] Explicit dedicated_sla_eligible and constraints
[ ] Pinning behavior validated: pinned version does not auto-advance
[ ] Per-customer rollout policy compatibility (A/B vs canary)
[ ] Rollback strategy hint present (at least internal)
[ ] Support query: “show last N promotions for account X/model Y” works via internal API

C) Private (VPC/on-prem)
[ ] private_bundle_eligible computed conservatively (false unless all required artifact fields present)
[ ] tokenizer_id + tokenizer_sha populated
[ ] runtime_min_version populated and tested against bundle runtime
[ ] Upgrade bundle export includes generated release notes artifact
[ ] Deprecation policy present if older versions will be removed from bundles
[ ] Audit event retention/export requirements documented for private control planes

============================================================
TAB 5 — CUTOVER PLAN (PHASED)
============================================================
Phase 0 (staging):
- Run backfill job in staging; report missing required fields by model_id
- Validate changelog generator produces artifacts but does not publish to docs

Phase 1 (prod, silent import):
- Create metadata_v1 blobs for all existing models with internal-only “migration import” note
- No customer-visible release note generated unless a promotion event occurs after cutover

Phase 2 (gated promotions):
- Control plane blocks “promote to stable” if:
  - missing change_categories
  - missing change_summary_public
  - missing required compatibility fields for deployment mode

Phase 3 (rollout enforcement):
- Rollout eligibility enforced centrally
- Console change history + release notes feed enabled for all customers

============================================================
TAB 6 — VALIDATION QUERIES / METRICS (WHAT WE WATCH)
============================================================
- % models with valid metadata_v1 (target: 100% after Phase 1)
- % T0 models with tokenizer info populated (target: 100% for Private-eligible models)
- # promotions to stable blocked by missing public summary (expect spike week 1)
- # changelog artifacts generated per day vs # promotion events (should be 1:1)
- # redaction rule violations caught in CI (goal: >0 in early weeks, then trend down)
- Support KPI: time-to-answer “what changed?” for ticket after output regression

============================================================
OPEN QUESTIONS / TODO (NOTES TO SELF)
============================================================
- Decide final rule: are quantized variants separate model_ids or variant objects under a base model_id? (Quentin + Dylan alignment)
- For older records: do we allow semver 0.x vs force 1.0? (release eng preference: keep 0.x if truly preview)
- Private: do we require exact tokenizer_sha for *all* models in bundle, or allow “tokenizer bundle version”? Security/compliance likely wants exact.
- What’s the minimum “public note” text for stable promotions that are purely infra/kernels? (Probably “Performance and reliability improvements; no expected output changes” with guardrails.)

- 2025-09-24: created sheet + initial columns
